response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS zoneref, f.articount AS articount, (1.0 * f.articount) / t.total AS share FROM scanfeatures f CROSS JOIN t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.articount AS artifact_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s.share - a.avg_share) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
